source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Germany 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.quote: Adidas has unveiled the Germany national team Home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle, marking the final Home design released under the current long-standing partnership
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: the black/red/gold diamond chest graphic, three black shoulder stripes, black collar with red trim, and 'a woven label near the hem reads “adidas Germany – Seit 1954”'. The six launch photos (worn and flat shirt, front, sleeves, shorts, socks) show only the adidas performance logo, the DFB crest, the sleeve-cuff trim and a Climacool+ authenticity mark: no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's white 2026 home shirt (the final home design under its current partnership with the DFB) carries only the adidas logo, the DFB crest and the black-red-gold diamond graphic; the launch photos show plain sleeves and black adidas-striped shorts (Football Shirt Culture's launch description and images).
